answer.book: Vedel's Arcanorum Arminianismi Pars Quarta (Lugduni Batavorum, MDCXXXV), a Latin polemic against the Remonstrants in one volume: a dedicatory epistle to the magistrates of Leiden and a preface, then two books of chapters, each chapter examining one chapter of the Arminian Vindiciae.
